body.name: vecH
body.type: fixed supported-cell and outcome vectorization convention
body.def: Fix once and for all lexicographic bijections \(\iota_C:\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}(G^{+})\to\{1,\ldots,m_H\}\) and \(\iota_Y:\mathcal X_Y\to\{1,\ldots,k_Y\}\). Write \(\mathbf p_H=(p_H\{\iota_C^{-1}(j)\})_{j=1}^{m_H}\), let \(e_c^C\) be coordinate \(\iota_C(c)\) of \(\mathbb R^{m_H}\), and let \(e_y^Y\) be coordinate \(\iota_Y(y)\) of \(\mathbb R^{k_Y}\). Every gradient, Jacobian, covariance matrix, and component extraction uses these orders.
